zh: 非元音字符完全不动，只有元音之间按出现顺序做一次循环右移，元音所在的位置集合也不变。
先按顺序取出所有元音组成一个序列，把它整体右旋一位（最后一个放到最前面），再按顺序填回原来的元音位置。
记录所有元音的下标；若没有元音就原样输出。否则从后往前让第 i 个元音位置取第 i−1 个元音的字符，第一个元音位置取原来最后一个元音的字符。注意整行读入、保留空格，只去掉行尾换行。
en: Non-vowel characters never move; only the vowels shift one step to the right in order of appearance, and the set of vowel positions stays the same.
Collect the vowels in order, rotate that sequence right by one (the last vowel goes to the front), and write it back into the original vowel positions in order.

Record the indices of all vowels; if there are none, print the line unchanged. Otherwise, going from the back, give the i-th vowel position the character of vowel i−1, and give the first vowel position the original last vowel. Read the whole line keeping its spaces and strip only the trailing newline.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Extract the vowels, rotate them right by one, and write them back into the original vowel positions in order.

## Why it works

After rotation the first vowel comes from the original last one and the i-th comes from the original (i−1)-th, which moves every original vowel to the next vowel position. Only vowel positions are replaced; the other characters stay unchanged.

## Complexity

Time and extra space O(n).
